summary: This House resolution supports the goals of "Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD) Awareness Day" and recognizes the importance of raising awareness about this rare brain disorder.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is entirely focused on raising awareness for Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease (CJD), a specific health condition. While it doesn't propose changes to healthcare systems or funding, its core purpose is health-related awareness and implicitly supports public health efforts through surveillance and research. This makes healthcare a central theme.
